name: 70506 · Lafayette, LA
findings: ZIP 70506 (Lafayette) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70506 (Lafayette) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 20 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
